extraction.Name: Birdie Biggins (Penne)
extraction.Recorded patent: The patent was recorded October 9, 1918, by John Penne (husband of Birdie)
extraction.Sold/Mortgaged: Mortgaged and sold; part of the allotment has been cut up into town lots and known as Penne Addition to the town of Winner
extraction.Buyer: Birdie Biggins Penne and John C. Penne mortgaged the land to the Rural Credit State of South Dakota for $4500, due December 1, 1920; Birdie Biggins Penne and John C. Penne mortgaged part of the land to Theodore Smok for $2400; this part was sold under foreclosure proceedings and sheriff's deed executed in favor of Theodore Smook September 3, 1924
extraction.NOTES: Fee patent No. 612828; Southwest quarter section 21, township 99, north of range 76; receipt for patent signed February 14, 1918 by the allottee; part of allotment cut up into town lots known as Penne Addition to the town of Winner; foreclosure proceedings with sheriff's deed executed in favor of Theodore Smook September 3, 1924; document dated 1929
